title: Connections.
officialText:
Direct connection of a steam exhaust, blowoff or drip pipe shall not be made with the building drainage system.
Wastewater when discharged into the building drainage system shall be at a temperature not higher than 150° F (65.6°C). When
higher temperatures exist, approved cooling methods shall be provided.
